title: Coddling, Kowtowing, and Delighting
description: Coddling, Kowtowing, and Delighting — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 20 Ice Orok Runts, 20 Ice Orok Scouts, and 4 Ice Orok Leaders in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 20 Ice Orok Runts, 20 Ice Orok Scouts, and 4 Ice Orok Leaders in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

To be honest, I don't know if Ice Oroks are even capable of being taught anything, so I want you to keep pounding it into their thick skulls that The Frump is not a man to be crossed. Unless you are, were, or will one day be married to him.

Head back into the main areas of Upper Frump's Misfortune and take out the Ice Orok Runts, Scouts, and Leaders. Finish them off and then make your way back into Frump's Interdungeonal Resort and talk to me, Junior Exec Ivan.

Turn-in:

Those Ice Oroks just don't get it do they. Let me know when you are rested up and ready to take another crack at those numbskulls.

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Orok Runts
  • Slain Ice Orok Scout
  • Slain Ice Orok Leaders

Level range: 25–35
